newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TWO MORE PEOPLE INJURED IN S.AFRICAN ZULU MARCH.
newsitem.headline: TWO MORE PEOPLE INJURED IN S.AFRICAN ZULU MARCH.

text.p: Two people were wounded on Wednesday afternoon when about 12,000 marchers began dispersing after a memorial service marking the deaths of over 50 people in a protest three years ago, South African police said.
"Two people were wounded and a number of arrests were made," police spokesman Sergeant Mark Reynolds told Reuters.
As marchers dispersed from Johannesburg's city centre, numerous gunshots were fired into the air but police -- closely guarding the sidelines -- did not fire into the crowds.
"We have no reports of police firing back at the marchers. They are dispersing relatively peacefully," Reynolds said.
Police said some of the demonstrators and bystanders had also attempted to loot shops at they made their way home.
Early on Wednesday two people were killed and two others hurt in the sprawling Soweto township when trouble erupted before the demonstrators boarded trains for the city centre.
